title: ISLAMICLEGALBENCH: EVALUATING LLMS KNOWLEDGE AND REASONING OF ISLAMIC LAW ACROSS 1,200 YEARS OF ISLAMIC PLURALIST LEGAL TRADITIONS
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (IslamicLegalBench) specifically designed to evaluate the religious knowledge and jurisprudential reasoning of LLMs within Islamic law (fiqh). It explicitly explores the ethical implications of AI providing spiritual guidance and addresses theological concerns regarding AI's role in religious practice.
